comparator.name: Global Arts, Culture and Politics (BA Cultural Studies)
comparator.sourceNotes: The official current study-programme page publishes a complete 180-ECTS structure: a 60-ECTS common first year, a 60-ECTS second year consisting of a 48-ECTS major plus two six-ECTS common courses, and a 60-ECTS third year with research lab, elective/minor space and final project. The normalized Cultural Studies target does not privilege one of four majors, so Curating the Past is selected as the first option listed in the curriculum table; its internal courses are not invented because the page publishes only the 48-ECTS aggregate.

comparatorRouteSelection.basis: The normalized target names the broad accredited Cultural Studies degree and does not privilege one of the four majors. Curating the Past is the first option listed in the official second-year curriculum table and is therefore selected before comparison with UCR.

alternativeSelection.assessment: The closest match owns the programme-defining global arts, culture, politics, media and representation interests. Sustainability/environmental politics and AI/algorithmic culture are the two strongest coherent remaining directions and yield feasible, substantively distinct programmes. Culture and social justice is already substantially covered by the closest match. Production stops at the maximum of three alternatives.

comparisonAlignment.rationale: Both introduce rhetorical analysis and purposive communication.
Both establish visual and media literacy for cultural analysis.
Both develop advanced persuasive communication and writing for audiences.
Both support advanced cultural and media production within a coherent thematic pathway.
Both introduce sociological approaches to culture, society and inequality.
Both introduce global political structures, power and conflict.
Both develop qualitative interviewing, observation and on-site research methods.
Both examine philosophical foundations of humanistic and social inquiry.
Both address ethical and societal consequences of artificial intelligence.
